scope: Day 2 (intake, disposal, leaving customers). XR Device Simulator with virtual keyboard/mouse. No HMD, no physical controllers, nothing about reach or comfort. FPS is desktop-only and not a VR measurement. Prices and the scenario are placeholders; customers are Rocketbox characters on a NavMesh in a placeholder store layout.
